explanation: Write left-prefix products into the output, then multiply them by a running right-suffix product while scanning backward.
correctness: Before the reverse scan, output[i] contains precisely factors left of i. The suffix contains precisely factors right of i, so multiplying them excludes exactly the required position.
walkthrough: For [2,0,-3,4], the left-product pass writes [1,2,0,0]. Multiplying right products into those entries gives [0,-24,0,0]. At the zero position, the other values multiply to 2*(-3)*4=-24; every other position includes the zero. Division is unnecessary.
spaceComplexity: O(n) result space and O(1) additional auxiliary space.
